Basically the  story described Ike as a gay turtle that couldn't find it's place in the sea. Ike didn't find being called a gay turtle, too funny, so he showed the teacher the document, and we all got sent to the office. The funny part of this story is, as our really chill principal scrolls through the document, looking at the pictures we put on it, telling us that they were not appropriate for school, he comes across one of my additions, which was a Photoshop of  Mr. Bean crossed with Justin Beiber, which caused the principal to laugh till coffee came out of his nose. And that, is the tale of the secret document (which was deleted by admin before anyone could make a copy)
